description: Given a list of integers, return true if it is sorted in non-decreasing order, i.e. every element is less than or equal to the element that immediately follows it, and false otherwise. Empty and single-element lists are sorted.
notes: VERINA: (forall i < |a| - 1, a[i] <= a[i + 1]) <-> result. The Dafny spec states the quantifier through the recursive predicate AdjacentSorted (with a {:fuel} hint) so that the verifier can decide a false result on the concrete test lists; it is equivalent to the quantified form used in the Python spec.
